scope.method: Finite actual-result engineering review. Reuse accepted host/launcher, actual freeze and combined functional closure; inspect original actual metadata, queue receipts, result and bounded stat/inode evidence.

admission_and_identity.result: Actual root top-level request/source/review/host/quiet/once-ledger references match current files. Actual F freeze, its independent acceptance, qualified-Q and root-Q links match. No source/full-functional requalification was borrowed from a different candidate.

execution.schedule: Ordered frozen native schedule equals attempted and completed lists exactly; 9264 unique IDs. samples.json has 4632 primary samples. No hidden prefix, appended sample or replacement is present in this execution identity.
execution.queue_checks: Six original metadata members were identity-checked separately for prelude, timing and audit. Prelude releases the original lease before timing starts; audit is a later separate W3 functional lease. Controller actual dispatch result agrees with the original timing result. Queue process wall/CPU/fault counters are not eight-stage CPU measurements.

pause_and_restoration.identity_check: Fresh F plan/ready/completed contain identical exact PID/image/creation/SID identities for the two allowed targets. Same existing PIDs are valid current identities; Q guard state/token is not reused.
pause_and_restoration.result: Passed. WSL ready-observed <= timing queue interval <= WSL stop request, requested_stop completion, exactly two held handles and one successful owned resume per suspended target. Both remain alive; no kill, restart or priority change. RESTORED reports user processes restored, error=null and power_error=null.
pause_and_restoration.ordering_proof: The actual pre-audit dispatch pins closed RESTORED, guard completion through RESTORED, completed power and whole-queue pause coverage identities. Restoration precedes original audit causally; no Windows-versus-WSL UTC ordering assumption is used.

power.actual_result: High Performance ready; requested_stop, restored=true, error=null. RESTORED before/after GUID evidence is the original Balanced GUID; original offline audit confirms valid_complete_power_window=true and restored=true.
power.scope: Unchanged original PowerWindow covers the native loop; it closes before later runtime/analysis/seal work in the timing queue. The 5520-second process guard covers that entire queue.
power.native_endpoint_receipts: c00000 and j04631 pass with timeout_seconds=20, returncode=0 and timed_out=false. Endpoint native span is 4442.010114251 seconds; no independent all-child receipt re-audit was repeated here.
power.background_scope: UnrealEditor/zenserver/Code and unrelated applications were retained outside the two-name pause scope. Controlled-project quiet is not physical host isolation.

runtime_and_outputs.pooling: All 27792 unique proof paths equal the 9264 attempted IDs times wire/canonical/queries. Every proof records full semantic validation before pooling, bytes preserved, first verified anchor or exact-byte comparison, and original native writable single-link storage. Seven anchors are currently readonly with expected link counts. First two and last two attempts' body slots match current anchor inode, size and readonly state.

bounded_stat_only_census.scope: Manifest-listed members only; manifest.json itself and original queue are outside this census. Sizes match all entries. Resource-ledger/status added after the ledger snapshot explain the increase, covered by declared metadata reserve. No large body contents were read.

runtime_and_outputs.accounting_boundary: Generated traffic, logical retained, inode bytes and allocated blocks remain distinct. Final original-audit retained scope includes copied frozen/protocol, manifests and queue. Inode/allocated counts are not total filesystem or VHD usage. Original audit reports no budget violations.

original_offline_audit.postrun_pin_verified: SHA256(SC-POST-RUN-PIN-v1 NUL + actual run-manifest digest bytes + timing queue-manifest digest bytes) equals the actual original-audit request pin.
original_offline_audit.truth_scope: Original unchanged auditor checks every completed conditioning and primary native child, receipts and output body bytes. Current frozen/run/timing-queue/resource references in the original report match the inspected actual identities.
original_offline_audit.statistics_boundary: The original report records target_achieved=false and promotion_eligible=false. Independent full statistical and cost-transfer review is separate; no primary/auxiliary confidence intervals are recomputed or reinterpreted here.

final_result_index.activity: Metadata-only index of the completed original run/audit and queue audits; no extra native child, body hash, capture or statistical test.
final_result_index.source_identity_boundary: The unchanged mathematical record does not itself verify external binary identity; actual source/binary/runtime closure is verified by the completed original outer audit and pinned runtime evidence, not inferred from that mathematical flag.
final_result_index.restoration_basis: Actual closed restore/power/coverage identities pinned before audit, plus within-WSL whole-queue coverage; no cross-clock UTC ordering.

conclusion.scope_limit: A successful engineering execution and complete audit are not evidence that every formal competitor target was met, that all auxiliary costs are non-regressing, or that host noise was eliminated. Performance decisions remain separately bound to this unchanged single F64 window.
